name: Crosskeys Foodbank
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Crosskeys Community Centre. Open Mon and Wed for distribution. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Caerphilly County Borough Council Allotments
short_description: Caerphilly Council allotment sites in Crosskeys area
description: Council manages sites at Crosskeys and nearby areas. Plots from £25/year. Waiting lists available. Includes water access and storage.

name: Crosskeys Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run community garden within Crosskeys Park. Grows seasonal vegetables with harvest shared among volunteers. Welsh varieties grown. Open Sundays during growing season.
